raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Under DCP, #39115 donates a mamba checkpoint only when
`prefix_len % mamba_cache_chunk_size() == 0`. `PrefillAdder` cuts a chunk
wherever the prefill budget runs out, and every later chunk inherits that
offset, so a request donates every checkpoint or none. With nothing donated,
`effective_cache_len` is 0 and the KV segment never enters the radix tree.
#40907 restored the old rule only on the non-DCP branch. This PR keeps the
DCP mask and makes the cut land on the grid.

Kimi-K3 MXFP4, 8×MI355X, TP=8 DCP=8, fp8 KV, `page_size=32`,
`chunked_prefill_size=8192`, `max_running_requests=96`,
`mamba_radix_cache_strategy=extra_buffer`, HiCache on, agentic workload at
concurrency 48. Each row is the same 240 s window after warmup. The last two
rows share a host, so the recovery is a within-host measurement. The first two
identify the commit that introduced the regression.

| tree | host | `kv_evictable_tokens` | `mamba_evictable_tokens` | device cache hit | prompt tokens / 240 s |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fa8d22e665` (#39115's parent) | A | 11,382,528 | 473/480 | **91.5%** | 59.8 M |
| `6460082c05` (#39115) | A | 620,800 | 123/480 | 50.3% | 4.8 M |
| `main` (`8d1643b21e`) | B | 392,448 | 88/480 | **30.4%** | 3.3 M |
| `main` + this PR | B | 11,614,464 | 464/480 | **90.7%** | 59.5 M |

## Modifications

No-op unless `enable_mamba_extra_buffer` is set.

- `Scheduler.init_mamba_truncation_align()` folds `mamba_cache_chunk_size()`
  into `truncation_align_size` with an LCM, the same way DSA kpool alignment
  does. This covers `exact_chunk_fill`.
- `PrefillAdder.floor_chunked_tokens()` rounds a truncated chunk down to that
  grid in `add_chunked_req` and `add_one_req_ignore_eos`.

A chunk that finishes a request may stop anywhere. A cut shorter than one
chunk is not rounded to zero. The unit test walks a 100k prompt through six
chunks cut to arbitrary leftover budgets and checks that each one still donates.

Once donation works, the mamba pool's working set grows. A 60-slot pool that
was sized while donation was failing can assert in `_alloc_ping_pong_buffer`
at concurrency 4 and long context. Raise `--max-mamba-cache-size`.
Concurrencies 8, 16 and 48 were unaffected.

## Accuracy Tests

No change to model outputs. Only the prefill cut moves.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

kimi-k3 AgentX 3600 s, concurrency 48, non-speculative. 2026-09-01 (pre-#39115) was
7272 tok/s/GPU; 2026-09-28 plus this PR is 7492 (103%), GPU hit 84.6%.
The rows span weekly images, so the eviction-pool table above is the
controlled measurement.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+    def floor_chunked_tokens(self, trunc_len: int, remaining: int) -> int:
+        """Round a *truncated* chunk down to the mamba kernel chunk grid.

+        The chunk that finishes a request may stop anywhere, so only shorten
+        when `trunc_len` really is a cut. Leave the cut alone when rounding
+        would empty it: making no progress is worse than losing a donation.

+        if self.mamba_chunk_grid <= 1 or trunc_len >= remaining:
+            return trunc_len
+        return trunc_len // self.mamba_chunk_grid * self.mamba_chunk_grid or trunc_len

+    def init_mamba_truncation_align(self):
+        """A mamba checkpoint may only be donated where the cached prefix sits
+        on the kernel chunk grid, so a chunk that stops anywhere else costs the
+        request every donation it would have made after that, not just one.
+        Use the LCM to preserve any existing alignment."""

+            )

+class TestChunkedPrefillStaysOnTheChunkGrid(unittest.TestCase):
+    """The scheduler side of the same constraint.
+
+    `test_dcp_depth_satisfies_tree_page_and_snapshot_grids` shows a prefix of
